findings.passage: “The best part is we didn’t just talk tough on the campaign trail,” Strickland said. “We win big elections. We came up here to the state Capitol and we fought for conservative policies and won conservative big policies here at the state Capitol. I’m proud of my record up here, things such as election integrity, the heartbeat bill, constitutional carry, mental health reform. I was able to come in and also fight against organized crime in our state.”
findings.note: Quoted in the Georgia Recorder story (reposted by NowGeorgia) on the day he launched his campaign for attorney general. He lists election integrity among his legislative record. It does not say which law or what it requires.
